verdict.rationale: The README says Solid's minimal abstractions give direct access to the DOM, making it easy to use native JS libraries like D3, and that a `<div>` is a real div. Community users back this up: refs are just the elements, and one developer calls Solid their go-to tool for data viz. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the integration pattern (refs, mount/cleanup lifecycle) beyond the README tagline.
